message.content:
I can help with this receipt. The image on page 1 shows a total of 45.00 DKK.

What would you like me to do?
- Extract a structured summary (merchant name, date/time, line items, subtotals, tax, total, payment method, receipt number).
- Verify the total against the line items (if visible) and flag any discrepancies.
- Convert the total to another currency or compute tips, etc.
- Export the data (JSON/CSV) for your records.
- Scan multiple receipts and compare totals or merchants.

If you want, I can go ahead and pull out all visible fields from the image now and present a clean summary. Also, if there are more pages, let me know and I can extract across all of them.
